newsitem.title: USA: CME to trade monthly DJ Taiwan Stock Index futures.
newsitem.headline: CME to trade monthly DJ Taiwan Stock Index futures.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange will begin trading monthly, instead of quarterly, contracts on Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index futures and options on futures on Friday's GLOBEX session, the exchange said Thursday.
March through December 1997 monthly futures contracts, instead of March, June, September and December quarterly contracts, will be traded.
"In talking to market participants, they preferred a monthly expiration," Norman Mains, CME's research director and chief economist, said in an interview.
The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) on February 14 approved the listing of non-quarterly Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index contracts, the CME said.
March through May 1997 options on March through May futures will also be listed Friday, as the monthly options contracts will now have identical expiration dates with futures.

The February 1997 option on the quarterly March Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index future will expire at 1030 CST/1630 GMT on Friday. The April 1997 option on the June futures contract was delisted last Friday, and the May 1997 option on the June futures contract will not be listed.
